title: Paediatric ACL Injury
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Read the tibial attachment before the ligament, since that is where the bone fails.
Assess the fragment's position and whether it is rotated, because a displaced fragment is a mechanical problem.
Read the physis in both bones, because a cruciate mechanism in a child can injure the plate as well.
Read the menisci, as the association that holds in adults holds here too.
